data.one_liner: Generates ObjectBox binding code for annotated Dart entities.
data.what_it_does: Scans Dart files for ObjectBox annotations and creates the necessary generated code to register entities with the ObjectBox database. Integrates with build_runner to produce model files automatically.
use_when: Using ObjectBox as the local database and want automatic model code generation
You need fast, ACID‑compliant local persistence with minimal manual boilerplate
avoid_when: You are not using ObjectBox (e.g., prefer SQLite, Hive, or Drift)
You want a pure‑runtime solution without a build step
strengths: Zero‑runtime reflection – generated code is fast
Seamless integration with ObjectBox Flutter package
weaknesses: Works only with ObjectBox, not a generic solution
Requires build_runner and adds a compile‑time step
data.setup_notes: Add objectbox_generator and build_runner to dev_dependencies, run flutter pub run build_runner build to generate code

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: SQL‑centric ORM with its own code generation

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight NoSQL storage without native code generation
